title: Improving Vision-language Models with Perception-centric Process Reward Models

access.version_observed: PDF p.1 arXiv:2604.24583v1 [cs.CV] 27 Apr 2026; latest remote version not checked
access.appendix_status: No appendix present in this 11-page local PDF; no complete teacher/judge prompt or training hyperparameter appendix.

rs.innovation_approach: 把外部视觉事实检查器训练成返回错误原文片段的生成式 PRM，在已有 GRPO 优势之后只缩减这些片段的正信用或放大负信用；同一 PRM 另用于推理时截断重生成。
rs.key_step: 将 Perceval 输出的 exact substrings 映射为 token 掩码 m，令 A′=A−αm|A|；仅 perception-related RL 数据使用该修正，其他数据保持 GRPO。
rs.why_non_obvious: 终答正确不保证中间视觉事实正确；把外部批注定位到字串，使标记 token 与同轨其他 token 接收不同幅度的信用。但它依赖已有非零 A，不能凭 PRM 在零优势组制造信号。
rs.trigger_condition: When outcome rewards cannot localize visual hallucinations and an external verifier can return reliable exact error spans, apply post-normalization token-specific advantage attenuation to suppress those spans.
reviewer_praise: low_evidence: manifest has no reviews_path and no independent review artifact was supplied.
reviewer_concern: low_evidence: reviewer concerns unavailable; reader-identified limitations are separated below.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: decision=null copied from manifest; arXiv v1 is not an acceptance decision.
rs.abstract_strategy: Localize externally verifiable errors before applying differentiated learning pressure.
rs.abstract_key_step: Return exact faulty substrings, map them to a binary mask, and reduce their signed update by a nonnegative fraction of its magnitude.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: A global success signal conflates local correctness; a localized multiplier changes credit without supplying a new nonzero signal when the global update vanishes.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When a global outcome cannot identify local faults but an external checker can ground them, restrict additional penalties to aligned faulty segments.

signatures.object: PRM training data and structured visual-factuality verifier
signatures.information: Schema is image v, query q and complete model response o. Teacher example is Gemini-2.5-Pro; responses example Qwen2.5-VL-7B. No gold-answer argument appears in the stated schema; complete teacher prompt, hidden annotations, resolution and actual GT access are unreported. Complete o includes later claims/answer, so not a prefix-only causal judge.
signatures.operation: Generate three responses per source query, obtain hallucination-focused teacher annotations, SFT Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B to emit think analysis plus exact erroneous source strings.
signatures.output: A Python list of erroneous response substrings or The response is correct.
signatures.claimed_effect: Structured PRM is the enabling component; no standalone precision/recall, held-out human agreement or isolated PRM-size ablation is reported. Downstream Table 1 reports 3B V* 80.10→83.25 when combined with token reweighting.
conditions: Reliable visual grounding by teacher and distilled PRM
Exact substring correspondence and correct text-token alignment
Perception data sourced from DeepEyes and SophiaVL-R1; counts and splits unknown

signatures.failure_boundary: Visual factuality is neither caption sufficiency for solving the task nor current-policy crop necessity. No human-calibrated reliability guarantee; no complete prompts/GT-exclusion audit.

signatures.object: Token advantages within perception-related GRPO responses
signatures.information: Full response, input image/query and external PRM span mask; sequence reward and group mean/std. Does not observe same-state answer-vs-crop counterfactuals or per-call causal benefit.
signatures.operation: Exact-match flagged substrings to token spans; after group standardization use A′_it=A_i−αm_it|A_i| with α=.1; unflagged tokens and non-perception training samples remain baseline.
signatures.output: Sign-preserving (or zero at α=1) token advantage, not an independently grounded action value.
signatures.claimed_effect: Table1: 3B V*all80.10→83.25 (+3.15pp), MathVision23.36→26.32 (+2.96pp); 7B V*all84.29→86.39 (+2.10pp). Not universal: 3B BLINK49.13→48.75 and 7B ChartQA85.16→84.44. Results are reported combined-method effects, not scientific replication.
conditions: Perception-related training sample gate; gate implementation not given

signatures.failure_boundary: A=0 implies A′=0. High α=.3 hurts several benchmarks; irrelevant words inside erroneous substrings receive penalty too. No matched random-mask control or independent judge validation.

signatures.information: External PRM sees image, question and the completed candidate; policy regeneration sees the original image/question and retained prefix, optionally PRM correction text. No answer GT is stated for this loop; evaluation GT judge is a separate stage.
signatures.operation: Find first flagged span, truncate before it, regenerate suffix; optionally append correction/reflection prompt; repeat until no flags or cap k∈{4,8,16}.
signatures.output: Revised response after verifier-guided sequential search.
signatures.claimed_effect: Table2 at k=16: Truncate V*all89.53 versus majority85.86 (+3.67pp), BLINK49.45 versus48.41 (+1.04pp); Truncate-Thinking88.48/49.38.
conditions: Useful prefix survival and regeneration support
External PRM available at inference; iteration count does not equal compute

evidence.quote:
We truncate the hypothesis before the
first token of that span, preserving only the verified prefix

signatures.failure_boundary: PRM misses leave false prefix; false flags discard good continuations. Reflection variant weaker at k=16, attributed by authors to missing reflective data. No measured latency/token/GPU cost or equal-total-compute comparison.

limitations.text: Authors attribute degradation at large α to punishing factually benign tokens inside whole spans; this is an explanation, not a separate controlled causal experiment.
limitations.quote:
Conversely, an excessively large α of 0.3 proves counterproductive. We attribute this to collateral “penalization”: since
the P ERCEVAL flags entire substrings, a high penalty indiscriminately punishes all tokens within that span, including syntactically necessary but factually benign words (e.g.,
articles, prepositions). This introduces significant training noise and degrades overall performance.

limitations.text: Authors hypothesize insufficient reflection data causes worse instruction following for inserted feedback; no supporting training-data ablation.
limitations.quote:
We hypothesize
that the model’s training data does not contain sufficient reflective data, which results in poorer instruction-following
quality when the reflective prompts are inserted in the Feedback strategy.

question.observed_failure: No controlled pre-method hallucination benchmark rate is provided. Fig2 shows the method training PRM-flag rate roughly .53 initially, .37 around step40 then returning near .49 late (visual approximate reading), not independent error gold. Baseline 3B V*80.10 and MathVision23.36 supply task metrics, not measured credit-assignment failure rate.
question.load_bearing_assumption: Outcome correctness gives adequate uniform credit to every intermediate token; authors challenge this because visual claims can be erroneous within the chain.
question.scope: Local visual-fact errors in text reasoning of Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B; intrinsic perception improvement and separate inference refinement. No multi-turn crop-necessity learning study.
question.success_criterion: Improve downstream benchmark accuracy versus GRPO; local factuality improvement should additionally require a held-out independent/human factuality measure (reader requirement, absent).
question.why_open: Outcome rewards cannot identify local errors; traditional step supervision is costly and some reasoning claims require future derivations, whereas visual claims may be checked against input evidence.

moves.note: Executed α sweep isolates one stated intervention variable; unknown remaining hyperparameters/seeds limit actual controlled-comparison verification.

moves.note: Partition response tokens by external visual-error labels; assign a tailored attenuation only to flagged subset. No claim that the broad pattern problem is resolved.

equations.locator: Eq.2 p.2, faithfully transcribed as printed
equations.note: Printed min uses unprimed A_i in first branch and primed A′_it in clipped branch, although §3.2 says substitute A′ into GRPO. No silent correction: likely typesetting inconsistency; actual implementation unverified. No 1/|o_i| shown.

objective.signal_routing: Outcome reward is standardized once per response group and broadcast to response tokens; only exact-matched perceptual-error tokens get −α|A_i|. No caption/crop/answer semantic partition is specified. Mask could cover any flagged substring in full response. Non-perception training samples use ordinary GRPO; inference truncation is not a training-token routing rule.
objective.normalization: mean+std in Eq1; α is applied after normalization in Eq3, no second normalization reported. Eq2 token sum has no explicit length divisor. Zero-std epsilon, group size and reward decomposition are unreported.
objective.invariance: Reader algebra: α∈[0,1] preserves sign of each baseline token advantage (positive can become zero at α=1), not relative response ranking or expected policy gradient. α=.1 gives .9A on positive flagged tokens,1.1A on negative flagged tokens. This is biased credit reweighting, not PBRS, action-independent baseline or proof of unchanged optimal policy. Authors phrase preserve sequence-level preferences overstates what sign preservation alone proves.
objective.baseline_or_potential: Group empirical outcome mean and std, no learned value baseline or potential. SFT-trained external Perceval supplies factuality mask; co-training updates not reported, treated as a fixed critic by method description, not repository verification.
objective.degenerate_cases: α=0 or empty mask returns baseline. A_i=0 leaves all flagged tokens at zero. All-equal rewards give 0/0 in printed Eq1: numerical convention unreported; if epsilon-stabilized, all-correct/all-wrong groups yield zero and no process correction. G=1 likewise undefined/zero under common stabilization. Positive flagged tokens remain positively reinforced for α<1; hallucinations in successful responses are not automatically punished with negative credit. No resampling/balanced first actions, so p(action)≈0 has no support rescue; single-turn responses still permit span reweighting but cannot establish crop credit.

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Reported: GRPO vs PRM-assisted training at 3B/7B, α∈{0,.03,.1,.3}, and separate k∈{4,8,16} inference comparison against majority vote. These test combined effect and dosage, but no shuffled/matched-span mask isolates semantic information from generic token suppression; no exact compute match established.
controls: Two model sizes (same Qwen family), multiple benchmarks
Non-perception RL examples receive standard GRPO; math gains are cross-task transfer under mixed-data training, not no-math-training generalization
Inference majority voting at same nominal k, not equal total verifier+policy compute

negative_results.quote: Conversely, an excessively large α of 0.3 proves counterproductive.

negative_results.text: Truncate-Thinking loses to Truncate at k=16 V*all88.48 vs89.53 and BLINK49.38 vs49.45; authors offer reflection-support hypothesis.

evidence_design.seeds: Not reported. No seed count, confidence intervals or statistical test; do not assume single seed or interpret significant as a statistical result.
evidence_design.falsifier: Proposed, not executed: equal-length/equal-count shuffled masks matching penalty mass should fail to match true-mask gains on blinded human factuality and held-out accuracy; equal-total-token/GPU-budget inference should retain benefits. If shuffled masks match, or independent factuality worsens while PRM rate improves, semantic grounding claim is unsupported.
evidence_design.independent_verifier_limit: Fig2 uses the same PRM to assess its trained policy. Curve stabilization or nonmonotonicity cannot establish absence of reward hacking; no independent human/other-judge holdout or perturbation control.

raw_negative_table_findings.finding: 3B BLINK49.13→48.75 (−.38pp); 7B ChartQA85.16→84.44 (−.72pp). These contradict a literal universal improvement reading.

engineering.cost: No dataset counts, training tokens, updates, hardware, GPU-hours, PRM inference latency or total serving compute. Fig2 x axis reaches ~340 steps but is not an explicit reproducible update budget. Equal k is not equal cost: PRM calls plus variable retained prefix and early stopping matter.

pitfalls.text: Whole-substring penalties affect grammar/benign words, degrading performance at larger α; smaller α=.1 is selected.
pitfalls.quote:

the P ERCEVAL flags entire substrings, a high penalty indiscriminately punishes all tokens within that span, including syntactically necessary but factually benign words (e.g.,
articles, prepositions). This introduces significant training noise and degrades overall performance.

engineering.code_status: Paper announces future public release; repository not opened or executed.
engineering.lesson: 当外部 PRM 返回整句错误 span 时，过强 token 加罚会连带压低无错语法词；应核对 span/token 对齐、保留未标记 token 的结果信用，并用独立事实标注与等掩码负对照验证，不把 PRM 曲线稳定当作无 hacking 的证明。
engineering.alignment_unknowns: Exact string matching is specified, but repeated substrings, failed matches, Unicode normalization and character-to-token boundary policy are not; unknown masks must not silently become correct.

relevance.how: 可迁移其视觉事实字串核验到 SFT caption 审核；论文实际训练的是 PRM 和 RL policy，未验证修复/屏蔽 SFT loss 的效果。
直接提供对视觉幻觉 token 的 RL 优势修正，但不保证 caption充分性/因果忠实性；需要独立事实性评估。
只能作为裁图后 caption 事实检查器的邻近设计；没有逐次crop取证/必要性标签，也未训练工具策略。
仅惩罚错误视觉事实，不保护事实正确但终答错误的caption，不能直接解决读出映射失败。
同一PRM训练与评分的reward-hacking自证风险；无独立可靠性证据。
额外视觉PRM调用开销未测，推理的相同k不构成等算力比较。
